subject: Constant conditional expression
notes: kb/Work PB1371 landed (wave 68 s). a)-c) were verified by the registrar (row history); d) "A complex condition as specified in 8.8.4.9, Complex conditions ... Abbreviated combined relation conditions shall not be specified." (cite.py --check 7.3.8.2 OK) was the divergence: XOR / EXCLUSIVE-OR were malformed (COBOL1619) at 2023 and 'NOT NOT' was accepted. Now XOR/EXCLUSIVE-OR are cce connectives at 2023 (golden K1-K5), gated COBOL0900 below 2023 (negative pb1371-cce-xor-below-2023), 'NOT NOT' is malformed at every edition (negative pb1371-cce-not-not), and abbreviated relations stay unparseable in a cce (no succeeding-tier arm: '1 = 1 OR = 2' COBOL1619).
